design_philosophy.description: DAVWO requires a hyper-intelligent, clean financial-dashboard feel. The core app runs in a light theme using crisp white surfaces, soft pastel KPI cards, and brand-green accents. The landing/login hero uses a deep dark navy (#0a0f1c) with glowing green accents to create a high-tech 'intelligence engine' vibe.
design_philosophy.emotion: Trust, High-Tech Intelligence, Sustainable Growth, Precision
design_philosophy.branding: Green/blue/orange leaf+wave mark with 'DAVWO' wordmark in green. Green is primary action color.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.global_spacing: Generous on marketing pages (p-12 to p-24), dense and precise on dashboard (p-4 to p-6).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border bg-white, navigation links have rounded-md, active state has bg-primary/10 and text-primary.
layout_and_spacing.cards: rounded-xl to rounded-2xl, subtle shadow-sm. No borders on inner pastel cards.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento-style for marketing. Control-room grid (tight gaps, col-span logic) for dashboard.

pastel_kpi_card.container: rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md relative overflow-hidden
pastel_kpi_card.backgrounds: Use inline HSL or extend tailwind bg-mint, bg-sky, bg-lavender, bg-peach. (e.g. bg-[hsl(var(--mint-bg))])
pastel_kpi_card.content: Top right pulse dot for live data (w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500 animate-pulse). Large numeric metric (text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900). Chart sparkline or Phosphor icon at the bottom.

dark_ani_panel.container: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-[400px] bg-[#0a0f1c] text-white p-6 shadow-2xl z-50 flex flex-col border-l border-white/10
dark_ani_panel.header: Flex row, AI glowing avatar, 'ANI™ Assistant' text, minimize/close buttons.
dark_ani_panel.chat_bubbles: User: bg-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 text-sm. ANI: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 text-sm with embedded Recharts data visualizations.

ani_recommendation_card.container: bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20 rounded-xl p-4 relative overflow-hidden
ani_recommendation_card.decoration: Sparkle/Star icon in primary color in top left. Text is dark slate. Action button is primary.
ani_recommendation_card.interaction: Pulse animation on the icon. Hover brightens the background to primary/10.

status_pill.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border

charts.styling: Use Recharts. Line charts: smooth curves, no grid lines (or very faint horizontal only), stroke width 2. Donut charts: rounded corners on segments, large inner radius (80%) for minimal ring look.
charts.colors: Primary green, secondary navy, and soft pastels for categories.

demo_scenario_card.container: bg-white border border-border rounded-xl p-6 hover:shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer group
demo_scenario_card.content: Icon in a colored rounded square, Title text-xl font-semibold, description text-slate-500, metric outcome in bold green.

motion.kpi_counter: Framer motion `useSpring` and `useTransform` for number counting up on mount.
motion.live_pulse: CSS animation `animate-pulse` on a 8px rounded-full div.
motion.chart_entrance: Framer motion `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` staggered by 0.1s for dashboard elements.
motion.ani_typing: Three small dots bouncing sequentially using Framer motion.

icons.library: lucide-react (fallback to @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard needs)

image_urls.description: EV Charging plugged in, use for landing page infrastructure imagery or case studies.
Neon city skyline dark. Use as a heavily darkened background image (opacity 20-30%) behind the ANI diagram on the left split layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend tailwind.config.js to include specific pastel colors (mint, sky, lavender, peach) and map HSL variables.
Install Google Fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans) and apply globally.
Use standard Shadcn components for tables, tabs, inputs, and dialogs. Customize their border radius to rounded-xl/2xl where appropriate.
Ensure every single interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards that open modals) has a semantic data-testid attribute.
Implement real-time simulation using `useEffect` with `setInterval` to randomly increment/decrement KPI values slightly every 5 seconds to show 'live' data.
Build the dashboard with a clean white sidebar, and ensure active states use text-primary (green) and bg-primary/10.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering child elements in the dashboard.
Create the 'Demo Module' pages as a seamless journey accessible from the landing page. Make sure all specified routes are linked.
For the ANI panel/chat, ensure it floats above the UI on the right side and uses the dark color palette (#0a0f1c).
